t.why: Attacks by Sahel armed groups are rising in the north.
t.rel: It clashed with neighboring Niger over the border and a pipeline after the 2023 coup. With Nigeria to the east, smuggling and cross-border trade are big issues, and attacks by armed groups are rising along its northern borders with Togo and Burkina Faso.
t.know: It is known for the female warriors of the Kingdom of Dahomey.
t.etext: Cotton is the biggest export, and re-export trade to neighboring Nigeria props up the economy. It is building up the port of Cotonou to become the gateway for landlocked countries.
